hypothesis: The frozen stdlib-only Go type observer cannot resolve a real declared interface/type alias dependency across supplied local packages. A separate bounded source-graph observer can typecheck exact two-package application sources without stubs, imports from disk/network, codec execution or runtime-binding claims.
new_scope: Isolated owned research observer v3; no production integration/permanent tests.
language_profile: go1.27 with existing Go1.27.1 SDK; actual inspected backend/go.mod declares go1.27, unlike frozen v2go1.24 profile.
required_behavior: Reject unknown/trailing/duplicate JSON keys before decoding source graph.
Require unique supplied source package paths; forbid replacing frozen stdlib/unsafe.
Recursively resolve only supplied source packages or existing SHA-verified frozen standard exports.
Reject missing source package, cycles, type errors in any supplied package including unreferenced ones; emit no admitted partial relation data.
Bind exact input file SHA and source graph; compute method/field/qualified relations with go/types, not name matching.
Do not execute source, package init, codecs, tests, model, network or installs.
owned_development_controls: Valid two-package interface and type-alias relation
Interface method selection not concrete runtime target
Error in dependency prevents all admitted relations
Unreferenced erroneous package still fails whole provided graph
real_source_probe: Unchanged Go Image Optimizer imageprocessing/image.go + imagecompression/usecase.go only. Actual compressor/router closure has codecs/external dependencies and remains outside this typecheck; no synthesized stubs.
